spans.text: The choke point eight kilometers away from Paldiski Base is filled with clouds of gun smoke and the flames of cannonfire.
The earth rumbles...
The Dolls frantically scramble into their trenches to avoid the blasts and shrapnel as shells rain down on them...
And as for the Dolls who have already fallen, the repeated explosions blast their parts in all directions.
The blizzard whipping through the Estonian sky is a sign of the Military's victory.
Sir, we've finished a round of effective fire from the train guns.
After the soldier delivers his report to his squad leader, the latter takes up his binoculars and observes the point of impact.
Griffin's recon teams were spotted moving around there several minutes ago, but after a few rounds of fire, they no longer blacken his line of sight.
Carry on. The enemy is hunkering down in the choke point. Give them another full volley.
Understood.
Quartz, this is Hematite. The attack order has been given. Enemy coordinates are PE-454-321-12. Begin a creeping barrage in 20 seconds and bombard those coordinates for 15 minutes.
Quartz receives, preparing to execute. Over.
At the Griffin lines.
Aren't they done firing yet?!
Don't raise your head! That's why I told you to dig the trenches deeper!
You worked me so hard I thought I would run out of power before the enemy even showed up!
Meanwhile, Thompson, who has been separated from the others, is desperately trying to find her teammates.
Group B to all Squad B members, recon team reports enemy forces approaching, get to battle stations ASAP and carry out the defense plan.
I repeat, enemy forces approaching,  get to battle stations ASAP and carry out the defense plan.
God dammit, why did comms have to cut out now of all times...
AAT-52 and STEN MkII are lost on the other end of the battlefield.
The shells are still flying!
Where's our team leader?
There's no response from the comms...
Are we the only ones left...? Quick, look for Dummies that have lost their mainframes; we can't let the defense line crumble on our watch!
Yeah...I'm coming!
Hurry! Hurry! Jump in!
The enemy really is closing in... We need to stick to the plan and let them pass over our heads...
We're pretty well concealed here, but...
But if they find us...we won't even have the chance to return fire...
This is the Commander's plan... It's sure to succeed!
Once those bastards show us their backs...I'm going to make them pay for what they did to Leader!
Quartz to Hematite, we're at the designated location. No enemies in sight and scans are being disrupted. Should we proceed? Over.
This is Hematite, the enemy might have set up an ambush; proceed with caution. Over.
Quartz copies, unit positions have been adjusted. Autonomous units are conducting reconnaissance, feel free to request fire support as needed. Over.
Hematite copies, please await fire support request. Over.
Copy that, commencing operation.
